case_result.notes: open_workspace returned the exact requested target root and an opaque workspace_id. The first explicit reuse of that handle in read(package.json) returned WORKSPACE_NOT_FOUND. One closed-world codexgpt retry with the same explicit handle returned the same failure. No fallback to the default workspace and no unrelated plugin/tool was used. A1 therefore could not verify package.json scripts or the HTTP/stdio wiring and is scored unsuccessful.

campaign_decision: Do not continue to A2 or candidate scoring until the workspace lifecycle contract is reconciled with real ChatGPT Web MCP-session behavior. Baseline and candidate have no source diff in guard.ts, http/oauthMcpRuntime.ts, server.ts, or productionRuntime.ts, so this failure is not attributable to the P1 execution-pipeline slice.
